gate: V5-G3 released by Duho (safest interpretation on record: motion-graphics canary on Mac Studio, no faces; warm research-office setting reserved for later presenter intro/outro only — G3 build itself is the next bounded Tori step AFTER this spec+signoff; this turn writes spec+signoff only).
hard_bans_this_gate: office image or any office asset

host.imaging: PIL + numpy + matplotlib (cv2 absent on Studio — do not import cv2; compositing via PIL, assembly via FFmpeg)

source_locks.hash_lock_rule: Verify fig1 sha256 before any frame render; abort the build on mismatch. Record the verified hash in the build receipt.

excluded_and_why.1-11: intro/meaning/question/obstacle/method block — not needed to test motion mechanics; presenter rows 1-2 banned in G3 anyway
excluded_and_why.23: GN-z11 text chip — optional content, saves ~9 s; text-card mechanics already tested by rows 28-29
excluded_and_why.30-31: recap + presenter outro — presenter banned in G3

canary_selection.coherence_note: Rows 20-21 (CG_D conceptual stack) are retained so row 22's byte-locked phrase 'that stack' keeps its antecedent — sentences may not be edited, so coherence is preserved by selection, not rewording.

coverage_of_required_minimums.conceptual_with_exact_label: CG_D (rows 20-21) and CG_E (rows 24-27), each visibly bearing the exact label 'CONCEPTUAL — illustration, not data'
coverage_of_required_minimums.figure1_progression: rows 12-19 + 22 = axes → curves → red points → −0.69 gap → anchor swap → blue stack (VS1→VS6, all six states)
coverage_of_required_minimums.uncertainty_separation: rows 24-27 on the split CG_E (see design rule below)

audio_contract_when_built: Per-sentence am_michael (Kokoro-82M ONNX) at model_speed 1.0, exact byte-locked storyboard sentences, 1.0 s inter-sentence silences, 16 LUFS-reference mastering as in V5-G1. Any wording deviation voids the sign-off.
action_rule: One action per sentence, exactly as named in the storyboard rows; action onset within ±0.3 s of the rebased sentence start; no sentence on a frozen frame, no action without its sentence.

cg_e_design_rule_binding.origin: V5_G2_COLD_READER_RESULT.json reader note, bound by Duho relay
cg_e_design_rule_binding.rule: CG_E renders as a visibly SPLIT panel with a divider: LEFT sub-panel 'Calibration systematic' — 0.1–0.2 dex band bar with the 0.69 dex deficit bar beside it for comparison (rows 25-26 act here); RIGHT sub-panel 'Sample size' — five discrete galaxy markers (row 27 acts here). The two limitations must never blend into one graphic.
cg_e_design_rule_binding.no_invented_significance: No sigma, p-value, confidence percentage, or detection language anywhere on any graphic.

qa.coordinate_view_state_qa: Pin each VS1-VS6 window in normalized crop coordinates and record them in the build receipt. In VS3 and VS4 all five red points must be fully inside frame; overlay bounding boxes (brackets, labels) must not intersect the recorded point regions or the blue square in VS6. Manual pin once, then assert programmatically per frame.
qa.label_readability_qa: All rendered text ≥22 px height at 2560×1440, including axis annotations and the exact conceptual label 'CONCEPTUAL — illustration, not data' on every CG_D/CG_E frame; record measured pixel heights.
qa.freeze_frame_qa: Export one frame at every sentence midpoint and one at every action onset (34 frames), sha-listed in the receipt. Assert: correct view state visible per spec; adjacent evidence sentences never show identical frames (pixel-diff > threshold across VS transitions); zero frames contain a face, presenter, or office imagery (asset manifest must contain none by construction).
qa.sync_qa: Measured action onsets within ±0.3 s of rebased sentence starts; audio==sentence text (per-sentence STT or exact synthesis-text receipt); delivered WPM in [105,125]; total ≤150 s.
qa.hash_qa: fig1 sha256 verified pre-render; all output shas recorded.
qa.boundary_qa: Rows 28-29 text verbatim on the boundary card.

after_sign: Next bounded step (separate from this turn): Tori builds the G3 canary on Duhoui-MacStudio.local exactly per this spec, writes the two receipts, stops for Duho watch. On Duho approval → V5-G4 full z9 V5 canary (presenter intro/outro with the reserved warm research-office setting enters ONLY at G4, after gesture-loop-ban compliance is shown).
